content: Task queue system: am task claim (locks task), am task complete (unlocks next), am task blocked (marks blocked). Main agent creates queue, sub-agents pull without overlap. Polling approach as fallback - agents check am context periodically.
title: Sub-agent coordination design

content: Claude Code plugins must have 'hooks': './hooks/hooks.json' in plugin.json for hooks to be loaded. Without this, the hooks directory exists but hooks never fire.
title: Plugin hooks need explicit reference in plugin.json

content: claim_task and release_task use atomic UPDATE with WHERE clause to prevent race conditions. UPDATE only succeeds if precondition holds (claimed_by IS NULL for claim, claimed_by = agent for release). Check rows_affected to determine success. Retry loop in 'am task next' handles contention with up to 5 attempts.
title: Atomic task claiming with TOCTOU fix

content: Post-session hook calls 'am task release-all --agent <session_id>' to release all tasks claimed by ending session. Also runs 'am task cleanup-stale --timeout 30' to release tasks claimed >30 minutes ago (handles crashed agents). Prevents orphaned task claims.
title: Session cleanup for task claims

content: user-prompt-submit.js checks for .agentmem/ directory before running. If missing, outputs helpful setup instructions instead of failing silently. User sees 'run am init' guidance on first use.
title: Auto-init detection in hooks

content: Doctor command now: shows memory/task counts, checks Claude Code plugin, validates OpenAI key against API, provides exact fix commands for each issue (e.g., 'docker start agentmem-qdrant'), explains graceful degradation (what works without Docker/OpenAI).
title: Improved am doctor with actionable fixes

content: During 'am init', key is validated by calling OpenAI API before saving. Shows error if rejected, offers to save anyway. 'am doctor' also validates existing key on each run, shows '(invalid - check key)' if fails. Prevents broken keys from causing silent failures.
title: OpenAI API key validation

content: user-prompt-submit.js must escape $, !, \ and backticks in prompt before passing to shell. Without this, prompts containing $HOME or $(cmd) get expanded by the shell, causing incorrect context queries or command injection.
title: Shell escaping in hooks
